title: centaurea alophium
intro: Centaurea alophium, commonly known as Mountain Centaury, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, stress, and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea alophium, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include sedative, anxiolytic, and spasmolytic effects. Further research is needed to confirm the plant's efficacy and safety for human use, but its traditional use in folk medicine suggests its potential as a natural remedy for various health issues.
